linkRules.title: Index links
linkRules.description: Where ids outside GitHub link to: `regex => https://host/path/{id}` entries separated by `;` (`{id}` the whole id, `{1}` `{2}` the pattern's groups). Example: `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]+-\d+ => https://example.backlog.jp/view/{id}`. GitHub pull requests, issues and commits written with their repository (owner/repo#12, owner/repo@sha) link without a rule.
